Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
HCLTech is a global technology company, home to 220,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services.
 Our purpose is to bring together the best of technology and our people to supercharge progress. We’re supercharging progress for everyone, everywhere – our clients, partners and their stakeholders, our people, communities, and the planet.
 We are looking for a Lead Frontend Architect to drive the design and implementation of scalable, high-performance frontend solutions for our client's digital platforms. The role requires strong expertise in modern frontend frameworks, cloud-native architectures, and end-to-end web ecosystem integration .
 Key Responsibilities 
Define and own frontend architecture strategy for enterprise-grade applications
Design and implement scalable, resilient, and high-performance UI solutions 
Lead development using Next.js and modern frontend frameworks , including SSR and middleware capabilities
Collaborate across teams to ensure seamless integration between frontend, backend, and APIs
Architect solutions involving CDN, DNS, API Gateway, and cloud platforms (Azure) 
Drive adoption of best practices in UI/UX, performance optimization, and security 
Lead troubleshooting of production issues across frontend, API, and infrastructure layers 
Mentor and guide engineering teams, ensuring high-quality code and design standards
 Mandatory Skills 
Strong expertise in Next.js (SSR, routing, middleware) 
Solid understanding of frontend technologies (React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS) 
Experience with API integration (GraphQL, Apollo, API Gateways) 
Deep knowledge of CDN, DNS, and edge architectures (e.g., Akamai, Azure Front Door) 
Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services (APIM, networking, integration layers) 
Strong debugging skills across frontend, backend, and network layers 
 Preferred Skills 
Experience with micro-frontend architecture 
Knowledge of DevOps practices (CI/CD, monitoring, observability) 
Exposure to enterprise CMS platforms (e.g., Contentful, AEM) 
 Experience & Qualification 
 12+ years of experience in frontend / full-stack development and architecture roles
Proven experience designing large-scale enterprise web applications 
Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills
 Key Competencies 
End-to-end architecture thinking (UI to backend to infra) 
Ability to design resilient, scalable, and fault-tolerant systems 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills 
Excellent collaboration with cross-functional teams 
 Why Us? 
We are investing in your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at every level to help you find your spark;
We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good work-life balance and real flexibility;
Our company is extremely diverse with representation of 165 nationalities;
We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues across the globe;
We offer comprehensive benefits for all employees;
We are a certified great place to work and a top employer in 25 countries including Romania, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect;
 What do we offer? 
1066 RON monthly budget in Benefit Online Platform
25 vacation days/year.
Life Insurance cover.
The employees working on bank holidays will benefit either a paid day off in the next 30 days + 100% of the hourly base salary for that specific day OR 200% of the hourly base salary for that specific day.
Childbirth allowance of 7000 RON after 1 year in HCLTech.
In the first 8 weeks, the company will pay the difference of up to 100% for the parental leave granted to pregnant employees.
Unfortunate events allowance of 7000 RON for first degree relative granted from day 1 in HCLTech.
Internal trainings and certifications.
